name: Sphinx
title: Guardian of the Sands
summary: Erodes enemies fortitude and excel in longer drawn out battles.
lore: Stalking the great deserts at Aaru’s borders, the Sphinx stands sentry against monsters and foreign invaders, any who would bring harm to her lands. None can say where she comes from, or why she does what she does, but many an enemy of the Realm—including countless soldiers of Omeyocan fighting the War of Pyramids—have perished beneath her terrible claws.
archetype_description: Reduce incoming damage by 1% for each piece of plate armor attuned

awakening_bonuses.description: Also place [Immortal] on this hero for 2 turns.
When an ally reflects a Debuff, increase their RES by 10 (stacking up to 200) which stacks across waves.
Also, reduce the Divinity Cost of each ally’s Ultimate Ability by 5% (stacking up to 10 times) then fully restore their destroyed HP.
